findings.title: R35 (direction 22) is not in the tree the sweep judged
findings.detail: The integrator's 11:41 note asked for R35 before the round closed so that sweep 9 would judge a tree with it. The round closed at 11:49 without it: there is no PROSPECTIVE_P_PER_WORKER, forageRates().p still includes the spoilage term, and nutrientWeights is unchanged. The sweep's failures are the R35 case: 4 of the 6 non-viable runs fail the R27 carbohydrate-store check while holding 5.8-9.0 mg of protein (we #1, we #3, sg #3, pp #3). pp #3 also goes into the long-run winter with C 1.7 / P 8.4 and its queen starves.

findings.title: SG3 reads an open cell as sealed when its way to the air is longer than SEAL_FLOOD_RADIUS_BU
findings.detail: SG3 treats a null flood path as 'cut off'. floodNow stops at 40 BU without recording a leak, so a long open shaft reads as sealed. New test src/sim/colony/founding/sealLongShaft.verify.test.ts is RED and kept: a 15-degree shaft, 12 BU deep (about 46 BU long), with no plug and an open throat, reaches state sealed and phase lay. It is green on a tree with the dd966f1 dig.ts (no SG3), and the 55-degree control case is green. Fix: treat the radius cut like the sample cap (a leak is not ruled out).

findings.title: The founding long test does not guard SG1-SG3
findings.detail: The test passes if every Fair-or-better start but one per archetype gets workers out, but each archetype has only 1-3 such starts (kitchen-door passes with 0 of 1). Poor starts only need >= 60 %, against the >= 86 % the test itself derives. It was green on the 09:20 and 10:08 trees, where 3 of 25 start poses failed at the seal (sg #4, we #4, pp #1), so it would not fail if SG1-SG3 were reverted. Direction 20.1 asks for 4 of 5 per archetype. I did not re-run the 25 foundings here (about 2 min of CPU each).

findings.title: Predation 14 -> 41 in the fresh sweep, high rates in small colonies
findings.detail: 0.020 -> 0.050 predation deaths per outside worker-gd over the sweep (the round's paired arms: 15 -> 26). sg #2 lost 6 workers on day 6 at 10-11 workers (0.179 per outside worker-gd). pp #2 lost 6 and pp #3 7 at 11-15 workers (0.10-0.13). That is above R25's band for an established colony, in colonies whose R25 ramp is near 0. More workers outside for longer explains only part of it.

findings.title: R33 draft: a nearest worker who cannot nurse blocks the pile
findings.detail: draftsOf gives the pile to the nearest draftable worker before asking the allocator. A caste with nurse weight 0 (Atta major) gets the pile, requestTask refuses her on every think, and no other idle worker is drafted for it. New test src/sim/ants/behaviours/nest/tendDraft.verify.test.ts: case 1 is RED and kept; the control case with the major busy is green. Lasius is not affected. Fix: draftable should check nurse eligibility.

findings.title: Hygiene and exposure brood deaths rose
findings.detail: Hygiene deaths 9 -> 41 and exposure 6 -> 25 of 149 brood deaths after the hand-over, while untended deaths fell 80 -> 6. cpv #1 lost 19 to hygiene in year one, 7 of them eggs in one day in a one-chamber nest, and 14 more in year two.

findings.title: New Math.hypot in simulation code
findings.detail: This is against the project's no-Math.hypot rule, though the file already used it many times.
